title: Samatho
text: 1 Asaṅkhataṃ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ || taṃ suṇātha || || 2 Katamañca bhikkhave asaṅkhataṃ || || Yo bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo || idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhataṃ || || 3 Katamo ca bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || Samatho vipassanā ca || ayam vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || la || ||
